thread_title: Singtel Wifi calling
post_text: In Wifi calling, the phone makes a VPN to the provider's gateway. In case of Singtel & its MVNO, it is epdg.epc.mnc001.mcc525.pub.3gppnetwork.org 5G/4G or ios/Android should not matter as far as your wifi is concern (the gateway side can choose to reject) So unless you have a firewall blocking the 5G phones, it should not be a problem on your side. Starhub (& MVNO) uses a different gateway : epdg.epc.mnc005.mcc525.pub.3gppnetwork.org Simba gateway : epdg.epc.mnc010.mcc525.pub.3gppnetwork.org M1 (& Maxx) uses a non standard gateway : epdg.mobileone.net.sg Last edited: Oct 12, 2025
notes_manual: Technical explanation of Wi-Fi calling gateways across operators.
